verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists Sprinto's general compliance automation features (dashboards, integrations like Jira/JumpCloud, continuous risk monitoring) but nothing specifically describes per-employee workstation checks such as disk encryption, screen lock, or password manager status via an agent or MDM integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an endpoint/device agent, MDM-based workstation checks, and per-employee compliance tracking for disk encryption/screen lock/password manager.
